$description: Rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Each rule has severity error|warn. schema/semantic_validate.py reads these rules (including params and exemptions) at run time, so the graph and the validator cannot silently diverge; verify_all.py checks every rule id is implemented. No NO_ADJACENT_SAME_CATEGORY rule: the real homepage legitimately places three SHELL sections adjacently.

rules.description: A section whose contract has constraints.onePerPage appears at most once per page (keyed by section id).
Nodes appear in the same relative order as the declared template's node list.
A section with constraints.mustBeFirst (the backdrop) is the first node.
A section only appears on templates listed in its constraints.allowedTemplates (legal.* only on template.legal; system.not-found only on template.not-found).
hero/demo/ops-steps/manifesto sit after shell.main-sheet and before shell.footer-sheet.
On template.home the overlay-state sections come after shell.footer-sheet.
On template.home the sign-up form only exists inside overlay.sign-up-modal.
overlay.leave-confirm requires form.sign-up-form on the same page.
form.sign-up-form uses variant 'modal' on template.home and 'standalone' on template.sign-up.
At most one hero.* section per page. Exception: the hero-less templates (sign-up, legal, not-found) have none.
A page that hosts form.sign-up-form should also include overlay.leave-confirm (the original raises it for unsaved input).

Mode 'generation' only: rejects Operate's logo mark / logo-trace (roles brand-logomark, brand-logo-trace) or its name, legal entity or domain (blockedTerms.operateBrand). Assets are judged by the role availability pinned in code (PINNED_AVAILABILITY), not only by the registry. Mode 'clone' is unaffected.

Mode 'generation' only: rejects Third-party integration logos (role integration-logo) or third-party trademarks in text (blockedTerms.thirdPartyMarks). Assets are judged by the role availability pinned in code (PINNED_AVAILABILITY), not only by the registry. Mode 'clone' is unaffected.

Mode 'generation' only: rejects Source avatar art (role demo-avatar-image) or the names of people the source shows (blockedTerms.people). Assets are judged by the role availability pinned in code (PINNED_AVAILABILITY), not only by the registry. Mode 'clone' is unaffected.

Mode 'generation' only: rejects Proprietary product screenshots and media: demo scene, video poster, footer stills and loop, Operate's background texture (roles demo-scene-image, video-poster, footer-video-asset, background-texture). Assets are judged by the role availability pinned in code (PINNED_AVAILABILITY), not only by the registry. Mode 'clone' is unaffected.

Mode 'generation' only: rejects Source-specific copy: any string of 5+ words contained in (or containing) the clone copy corpus, or the source's demo entities (blockedTerms.sourceDemoEntities). Assets are judged by the role availability pinned in code (PINNED_AVAILABILITY), not only by the registry. Mode 'clone' is unaffected.

Mode 'generation' only: rejects Real or live URLs and endpoints: roles lightbox-video-stream, signup-submit-stub, external-social-link; Operate's profile handles; any absolute URL, bare domain, www host or e-mail whose host is not reserved (blockedHosts names the source hosts). Assets are judged by the role availability pinned in code (PINNED_AVAILABILITY), not only by the registry. Mode 'clone' is unaffected.

Repository-level check run with every PageSpec: every section contract carries a closed boolean retrievalEligible; runtime UI (overlay/modal/dialog/drawer/cookie/consent/toast/lightbox) and the layout-only sections pinned in code (RETRIEVAL_INELIGIBLE_PINNED in schema/semantic_validate.py and extraction/verify_all.py) are false with a 30+ character reason; nothing else is false; the allowlist mirror agrees.
